Consider the data in [table-lst-squares-line].

A dataset with four points. $x$ $y$ 1 1 2 1 3 1 4 2

Set up the linear system $A\xvec=\bvec$ that describes the line $b + mx = y$ passing through these points.

Write the normal equations that describe the least-squares approximate solution to $A\xvec=\bvec$.

Find the least-squares approximate solution $\xhat$ and plot the data and the resulting line.

What is your predicted $y$-value when $x=3.5$?

Find the coefficient of determination $R^2$.
